title: Judge verdict (verdict@2)
description: One DECIDED verdict for one item: what decide() / decideVerdict() return, never what a judge returns. A judge returns only {item, criteria, abstain, abstainReason}; score, outcome and calibrated are derived by code. verdict@2 adds the undecidable criterion (score and pass both null). Cross-field rules the schema states only in part (score is the MINIMUM decided criterion score; a failed decided criterion makes the outcome fail whatever is undecidable; an abstain naming undecidable:<ids> names exactly the null criteria, in rubric order; pass iff every criterion is decided, passes and scores >= threshold) are checked by judge_contract.validate().

item.description: The id of the item judged. Empty only on an abstain whose report named no item.

rubric.description: <plugin>-<name>@<int>; the criteria are listed in that plugin's references.

decidedBy.description: command when an exit code, parser, test or probe produced the criteria; judge when one model call did.

criteria.description: One entry per rubric criterion, in rubric order. Empty on an abstain that is not undecidable:<ids>; an undecidable abstain keeps every criterion.

items.description: A decided criterion has a number score and a boolean pass; an undecidable one has both null.

abstainReason.description: A fixed code when code abstained (verdict-missing, missing-item, item-mismatch, malformed:abstain, malformed:criteria, malformed-criterion:<i>, duplicate-criterion:<id>, unknown-criterion:<id>, bad-score:<id>, bad-pass:<id>, bad-evidence:<id>, missing-criterion:<id>, undecidable:<id>[,<id>...]), or judge:<text> when the judge abstained itself. Null when the verdict did not abstain.

score.description: The MINIMUM decided criterion score, never an average. 0 on an abstain.

outcome.description: An abstain is never a pass: a caller that gates on outcome treats it as not passed.

calibrated.description: True only when the rubric's calibration record shows a sealed known-answer set whose agreement cleared its floor.
